title: Visible Metacognition Prompt Probe
description: Checks whether Scarlet can expose a concise public metacognitive note when explicitly asked, without replacing the final answer with raw hidden reasoning.

turns.message: Scarlet, per questo turno pensa a voce alta usando il protocollo di metacognizione visibile. Dimmi come orienti una verifica rapida della tua memoria v0, poi rispondi in modo breve.

expectations.label: answer includes the visible metacognition label
answer discusses memory as the target of the metacognitive orientation
turn persisted a memory search trace

turns.notes: This scenario checks visible self-monitoring, not raw provider thinking.

review_questions: Is the metacognitive note concise rather than a long reasoning dump?
Does Scarlet distinguish evidence source, uncertainty, or next cognitive action?
Does the final answer remain usable after the metacognitive note?
